chars.MOM: MOM: a Moroccan woman in her early 40s, elegant, shoulder-length dark wavy hair, wearing a long modest dusty-rose satin nightgown covered by a matching long-sleeve robe tied at the waist
chars.BOY: BOY: an 18-year-old Moroccan young man, short black hair, light stubble, wearing a grey hoodie and black joggers, barefoot
